info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Domestic Payment Details API
info.description: The Domestic Payment Details API provides access to comprehensive information regarding specific domestic payments within the Open Banking framework. This API enables users to retrieve detailed payment status, transaction metadata, and associated account information. Typically used by banking applications and financial service providers, it serves developers who need to display or analyze payment details. By integrating this API, organizations can enhance transparency and customer experience in managing domestic payment transactions.

get.summary: Retrieve payment details for a specific domestic payment.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about a specific domestic payment identified by its unique payment ID (PAY-300045). The response will include all relevant transaction details, facilitating better tracking and management of the payment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the payment details for a specific domestic payment identified by PAY-300045. The request should include the necessary authentication and authorization tokens in accordance with the API's security requirements.
